address: 201, Second Floor, City Centre Mall, Rohini, New Delhi 110085

services.name: Cardiac Consultation
services.description: Complete heart health evaluation, medical history review, risk assessment
services.good_for: Chest pain, shortness of breath, high blood pressure, first time cardiac checkup

services.name: ECG (Electrocardiogram)
services.description: Records electrical activity of the heart, detects irregularities
services.good_for: Palpitations, chest pain, dizziness, routine heart checkup

services.name: Echocardiography (Echo)
services.description: Ultrasound of the heart, checks heart valves and pumping function
services.good_for: Heart valve issues, heart failure, pre surgery evaluation

services.name: Stress Test (TMT)
services.description: Monitors heart during physical exertion on treadmill
services.good_for: Chest pain during activity, checking heart fitness, post heart attack recovery

services.name: Holter Monitoring
services.description: 24 hour continuous ECG recording worn as small device
services.good_for: Irregular heartbeat, palpitations that come and go
services.note: Device worn for full day, normal activities can continue

services.name: Hypertension Management
services.description: Blood pressure monitoring, medication review, lifestyle guidance
services.good_for: High blood pressure patients, medication adjustment

policies.emergency: Please call clinic directly for cardiac emergencies
